en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded street procession in a historic European city. Large stone buildings with ornate facades line the street, with spectators watching from windows and balconies. The street is filled with uniformed men marching, followed by costumed figures on horseback wearing capes and headpieces, observed by dense crowds on both sides. Printed French text appears at the top of the card describing the event and location.
